Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast arcane spells per the Spells Per Day table, plus Bonus Spells from high Intelligence.

Scribe's Insight

  • Effect: Once per day, as part of casting a spell, swap one prepared spell for a different spell of the same level from your spellbook — the methodical, bookish caster rewriting their working memory on the fly.

School Focus

  • Effect: Choose one school of magic (see Spellcasting in Arneyan). The save DC of your spells of that school is increased by 1.

2nd Level

Arcane Recovery

  • Effect: Once per day, after 10 minutes of study, regain expended spell slots with a combined level up to half your Wizard level (rounded up). None may be above 5th level.

6th Level

Cantrip Expertise

  • Effect: Add your Intelligence modifier (minimum 0) to the damage of your damaging cantrips. Does not stack with the Cantrip Mastery feat.

13th Level

Detect Magic

  • Effect: After 5 rounds of study, an Intelligence check reveals the magical origin of an item whose kind of magic you have met before.
  • From 18th level it also reveals the item's power and history

15th Level

  • Intelligence Bonus: permanent +1 Intelligence

17th Level

Counterspell

  • Effect: Once per encounter, when a creature within 60ft casts a spell no higher in level than half your Wizard level, you may try to counter it as your reaction, using no slot: an Intelligence check against its save DC makes it fizzle, and a failure spends the attempt.

18th Level

Signature Spells

  • Effect: Choose two spells of 3rd level or lower from your spellbook. You can cast each once per day at its level without expending a slot.

20th Level

Perfect Recall

  • Effect: Recall a previously-cast 1st-level spell once per day via an Intelligence check (DC 10, the Easy tier), casting it again without expending a slot.
  • From 24th level: works for previously-cast 2nd-level spells

Kits: Arneyan Arcane Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Wizard folder. Drag one onto your character.

Wizard Kits represent the institution, tradition, or circumstance that trained the character in the arcane arts.

Wizard Spells Per Day

  • Bonus Spells: Intelligence 13–15 grants an extra 1st level spell, 16–17 an extra 2nd level spell, 18+ an extra 3rd level spell. Cumulative, and only acquired once the wizard is high enough level to cast that spell tier at all.
